notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) only - curl_cffi (impersonate=chrome124) direct HTTP fetch. Site is a Shopify storefront with server-rendered Liquid theme; robots.txt (checked first) is a standard Shopify robots file with User-agent: * Allow: / and only blocks admin/cart/checkout/account/ajax paths - no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot block, no block encountered on any request (all 200 OK). No Playwright/Claude-in-Chrome needed. TREE: Built from the site's mega-menu (parsed from homepage HTML, .main-menu block, ~200 links covering Living Room, Bedroom, Dining, Decor Accents, Wall Decor, Lighting, Garden, Home Fragrances, Kitchen, Furnishing, Gifting top-level columns) cross-checked against /collections.json (5 pages, 629 total collections via sitemap-equivalent enumeration) and each visited category page's own rendered link strip (bath-laundry, bedding, curtains pages checked - strips reproduce the same mega-menu, no additional subcategories found). This is a furniture+home-essentials retailer (Nilkamal) - the overwhelming majority of the 629 collections are Furniture/Lighting/Kitchen&Dining/Decor/apparel-adjacent and out of scope; only the Furnishing and a handful of Kitchen/Bath/Living-Room nodes qualify. QTY: taken from each leaf's own rendered collection-header text, pattern '<Name> (<N> products)', visible in the page HTML immediately after the H1/breadcrumb (e.g. 'Bedsheets (183 products)'); h1 and canonical URL were confirmed to match the requested handle on every leaf recorded (no silent wrong-number slugs found). EXCLUDED - out of scope categories: all Living Room/Bedroom/Dining furniture (sofas, recliners, tables, beds, wardrobes, chest of drawers, cabinets, TV units, dressing tables, night stands, ottomans - furniture per textile.md S21/storage.md S27), Wall Decor (paintings, wall arts - checked wall-arts products, all metal/iron decor, no fabric tapestries found), Lighting, Garden/planters, Home Fragrances/candles, Kitchen & Dining tableware/cookware/drinkware/cutlery, decorative accents (showpieces, vases, candle stands, wind chimes, water fountains, decorative bowls/trays, photo frames, clocks, mirrors), Gifting landing pages (promotional/collection pages, excluded per View-All/Collections rule). EXCLUDED - checked and rejected as neither Textile nor Storage: Hooks & Hangers and Coat Hangers (clothing hangers/wall hooks - hardware/accessory, not a containment or organizing product per storage.md, no explicit rule coverage); Dustbins and Soap Dispensers (bathroom accessories, not storage per rules); Bath Slippers (apparel/footwear); Roti Box handle (actual products are 'Cotton Bread Basket' - a fabric serving basket for rotis, judged a Kitchen&Dining serving item, not core home textile or storage/organizing product; LOW-confidence boundary case, excluded rather than force-classified); Ladders (utility tool, not storage); Serving Carts (storage.md S20 explicitly excludes serving carts whose primary purpose is serving/dining). DUPLICATE handling: 'Mats' (/collections/mats) was found to be a byte-for-byte duplicate product set of 'Bath Mats' (/collections/bath-mats) - same 24 product IDs, same qty - so 'Mats' was dropped and only 'Bath Mats' retained (textile.md S30 duplicate rule). Also checked and EXCLUDED a set of orphaned/unlinked collections discovered only via the collections.json/sitemap enumeration and not reachable from the live mega-menu or any category page's own strip: bath-robes, duvet-covers, shower-curtains, face-towels, carpet, laundry-bag-rugs-carpets, shelf-mat (all showed 0 products - dead/unlinked pages), and hand-towels, rugs (generic), runners (generic), napkins (generic), cushions (generic), cushion-cover (generic), filled-cushions, cushion-fillers - verified via products.json ID comparison to be near-total subsets of the already-recorded nav categories (Towels, Rugs & Carpets, Table Runners, Napkins & Napkin Rings, Cushions & Covers respectively), so including them would double-count the same products under a second, non-navigated URL. Storage.xlsx boundary note: /collections/storages ('Storages', 25 products) was found in the sitemap enumeration but is NOT in the live mega-menu; its products are Chests of Drawers, Sideboards and Drawer Pedestals - furniture per storage.md S21 boundary - so excluded regardless of nav status. Two grouping rows carry mixed-category children and appear (with different child sets) in both arrays: 'Furnishing' > 'Bath & Laundry' (textile children: Towels, Bath Mats, Door Mats, Rugs & Carpets; storage children: Laundry Baskets, Bath Organisers; excluded children: Hooks & Hangers, Bath Slippers, Dustbins, Soap Dispensers). 'Kitchen' similarly groups both Textile leaves (Placemats, Napkins & Napkin Rings, Table Runners) and Storage leaves (Jars & Containers, Cannisters, Containers, Organisers) alongside many out-of-scope Kitchen & Dining leaves not recorded here. 'Living Room' and 'Decor Accents' are recorded as storage_rows grouping-row ancestors solely because each contains exactly one storage-qualifying leaf (Shoe Racks; Utility Organisers respectively) inside an otherwise Furniture/Decor department - included per Step 2 rule 4 (only dropped if a grouping leads EXCLUSIVELY to the other array's leaves, not when it leads to out-of-scope/neither items).
